message: The other day, I was chatting with my neighbor about smoke alarms, and I casually mentioned how I had to replace mine last month. You know, the classic 'I told you so' moment hit when she realized hers was a decade old! We laughed about it, but it reminded me how easy it is to overlook safety at home. It's a good nudge to check those alarms and make sure we have an escape plan too. Has anyone else had a little wake-up call like that?
